trainers.ability: Gain MissingN.
trainers.ability_ko: MissingN.을 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Gain MissingN.

trainers.name: Black Belt
trainers.ability: On Battle Start If you have exactly 1 Fighting monster on your team, activate its On Victory ability.
trainers.ability_ko: 전투 시작 시 팀에 격투 타입 바토몬이 정확히 1마리 있다면, 해당 바토몬의 승리 시 능력을 발동합니다.
trainers.ability_en: On Battle Start If you have exactly 1 Fighting monster on your team, activate its On Victory ability.

trainers.name: Bug Catcher
trainers.ability: The first Bug monster you buy each day is free.
trainers.ability_ko: 매일 처음 구매하는 벌레 타입 바토몬이 무료가 됩니다.
trainers.ability_en: The first Bug monster you buy each day is free.

trainers.name: Burglar
trainers.ability: Trinket gifts only offer 2 choices, but you can take both of them.
trainers.ability_ko: 장신구 선물의 선택지가 2개만 제공되지만, 두 선택지를 모두 가져갈 수 있습니다.
trainers.ability_en: Trinket gifts only offer 2 choices, but you can take both of them.

trainers.name: Chef
trainers.ability: Your singled-typed monsters gain Fire typing. Your Fire monsters have +2 Burn.
trainers.ability_ko: 단일 타입 바토몬에게 불꽃 타입을 추가합니다. 불꽃 타입 바토몬은 화상 +2를 얻습니다.
trainers.ability_en: Your singled-typed monsters gain Fire typing. Your Fire monsters have +2 Burn.

trainers.name: Chemist
trainers.ability: Your Toxic monsters have +1 Poison. When any monster levels up, increase this effect by +1 Poison.
trainers.ability_ko: 독성 타입 바토몬은 독 +1을 얻습니다. 바토몬이 레벨업할 때마다 이 효과가 독 +1씩 증가합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Your Toxic monsters have +1 Poison. When any monster levels up, increase this effect by +1 Poison.

trainers.name: Egg Breeder
trainers.ability: Gain a Purple Egg that hatches into a level 2 Super Rare monster in 5 days.
trainers.ability_ko: 5일 후 레벨 2 영웅 바토몬으로 부화하는 보라색 알을 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Gain a Purple Egg that hatches into a level 2 Super Rare monster in 5 days.

trainers.name: Gamer
trainers.ability: Gain a Mythical monster and $30 on day 9.
trainers.ability_ko: 9일째에 신화 등급 바토몬 1마리와 $30를 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Gain a Mythical monster and $30 on day 9.

trainers.name: Gentleman
trainers.ability: From day 4 onwards, your shop no longer stocks Common or Uncommon monsters.
trainers.ability_ko: 4일째부터 상점에 일반 및 고급 바토몬이 등장하지 않습니다.
trainers.ability_en: From day 4 onwards, your shop no longer stocks Common or Uncommon monsters.

trainers.name: Lucky Girl
trainers.ability: SHINY monsters are more likely to appear.
trainers.ability_ko: SHINY 바토몬이 등장할 확률이 증가합니다.
trainers.ability_en: SHINY monsters are more likely to appear.

trainers.name: Mad Scientist
trainers.ability: On day 7, transform monsters on your active team into random level 1 Legendary monsters.
trainers.ability_ko: 7일째에 현재 팀의 바토몬을 무작위 레벨 1 전설 바토몬으로 변환합니다.
trainers.ability_en: On day 7, transform monsters on your active team into random level 1 Legendary monsters.

trainers.name: Masked Man
trainers.ability: Every 4 days, choose a trainer and gain their ability.
trainers.ability_ko: 4일마다 트레이너 1명을 선택하여 해당 트레이너의 능력을 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Every 4 days, choose a trainer and gain their ability.

trainers.name: Monster Ranger
trainers.ability: Start with an Uncommon monster. Get another copy of that monster every 2 days.
trainers.ability_ko: 고급 바토몬 1마리와 함께 시작합니다. 이후 2일마다 해당 바토몬을 1마리씩 추가로 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Start with an Uncommon monster. Get another copy of that monster every 2 days.

trainers.name: Musician
trainers.ability: If you have exactly 1 Electric monster on your team, it will have +150% Shock.
trainers.ability_ko: 팀에 전기 타입 바토몬이 정확히 1마리 있다면, 해당 바토몬의 감전이 +150% 증가합니다.
trainers.ability_en: If you have exactly 1 Electric monster on your team, it will have +150% Shock.

trainers.name: Painter
trainers.ability: Random species will be painted with every type this run.
trainers.ability_ko: 이번 게임 동안 무작위 종족의 바토몬에 모든 타입이 부여됩니다.
trainers.ability_en: Random species will be painted with every type this run.

trainers.name: Redhead
trainers.ability: On Victory Give your Fire monsters +2 Burn permanently.
trainers.ability_ko: 승리 시 자신의 불꽃 타입 바토몬에게 화상 +2를 영구적으로 부여합니다.
trainers.ability_en: On Victory Give your Fire monsters +2 Burn permanently.

trainers.name: Rich Lady
trainers.ability: Gain shop rank +2 and $10.
trainers.ability_ko: 상점 등급 +2와 $10를 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Gain shop rank +2 and $10.

trainers.name: Scavenger
trainers.ability: Gain an additional copy of each non-unique Common or Uncommon Trinket from a gift.
trainers.ability_ko: 선물에서 일반 또는 고급 비고유 장신구를 획득하면 해당 장신구를 1개 추가로 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Gain an additional copy of each non-unique Common or Uncommon Trinket from a gift.

trainers.name: Shopkeeper
trainers.ability: Your shop stocks Item 1 rarity tier higher and cost 15% less.
trainers.ability_ko: 상점에 1단계 더 높은 희귀도의 도구가 등장하며, 비용이 15% 감소합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Your shop stocks Item 1 rarity tier higher and cost 15% less.

trainers.name: Swim Coach
trainers.ability: Gain a random Water monster each day.
trainers.ability_ko: 매일 무작위 물 타입 바토몬을 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Gain a random Water monster each day.

trainers.name: Treasure Hunter
trainers.ability: When you get Trinket gifts, your choices are 1 rarity tier higher.
trainers.ability_ko: 장신구 선물을 받을 때 선택지의 희귀도가 1단계 높아집니다.
trainers.ability_en: When you get Trinket gifts, your choices are 1 rarity tier higher.

trainers.name: Twins
trainers.ability: When monsters merge into level 3, gain an exact copy.
trainers.ability_ko: 바토몬이 합쳐져 레벨 3이 될 때 동일한 복사본을 1마리 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: When monsters merge into level 3, gain an exact copy.

trainers.name: Youngster
trainers.ability: Gain 3 free rerolls every day.
trainers.ability_ko: 매일 무료 리롤 3회를 획득합니다.
trainers.ability_en: Gain 3 free rerolls every day.
